info.name: Prescription Management API - Complete & Tested
info.description:
Full Postman collection covering ALL implemented endpoints for the MVP, complete with tests and variable management.

IMPORTANT — Cookie-based auth requires `withCredentials` enabled in Postman:
Settings → General → "Send cookies and credentials alongside any request" → ON.

## Authentication Flow
Tokens are stored in HttpOnly cookies (NOT in response body). Login returns:
  { "message": "Login successful", "user": { "id", "email", "role", ... } }

## Run Order (recommended)
1. Login as desired role (sets cookie in Jar)
2. Run folder requests in sequence
3. Use negative tests to verify RBAC/IDOR protections

## Endpoint Summary (14 total)
  GET  /                          — health check
  POST /auth/login                — login (public)
  POST /auth/refresh             — rotate access token (public, uses cookie)
  POST /auth/logout               — clear cookies
  GET  /auth/profile              — current user profile
  POST /users                     — create user (admin only)
  GET  /users                     — list all users (admin only)
  GET  /users/patients            — list patients (admin/doctor)
  GET  /users/doctors             — list doctors (admin)
  GET  /users/:id                  — user detail (admin/doctor)
  GET  /prescriptions             — list (paginated, role-filtered)
  POST /prescriptions              — create (doctor only)
  GET  /prescriptions/:id          — prescription detail
  PATCH /prescriptions/:id/consume — mark consumed (patient only)
  GET  /prescriptions/:id/pdf      — download PDF
  GET  /admin/metrics             — dashboard metrics (admin only)
